contactForm.label: Contact form
contactForm.help: The "Send us a message" form on the contact page. A message lands in Support › Inbox as a conversation from his number, on the Contact form channel, with the order he names linked when it is his. Nothing is sent to him automatically; the team replies on WhatsApp or by phone. Off as it ships — turn it on once someone reads the inbox. Each number may send the set number of messages a day.
